risk_note: RV2 settlement / commission / ledger (B2-04zd; D10-443; BR-FUND-04, BR-FUND-09). Production ports for the monthly bill job: settlement readSource (read only: orders + order_settlements of the app / platform, orphan settlements as order=null; range, cut-off and greatest seq still checked by the bill job), saveBillValidations writing nothing (D10-443 (a)); ledger readUnionAuthoritativeOrderKeys always returns an empty set (no structured union-authoritative conclusion exists in recon_diffs.resolution; D10-447), so every order is compared on amounts (only blocks more, never pays more); commission appendBeneficiaryEvent appending commission_split_beneficiary_events on the caller's transaction with created_at from the injected Clock. Wiring is B2-04ze.
